_comment: Template for state/profile.json. Copy this file to ../state/profile.json during first-run enrollment (see SKILL.md) and fill it in. This is the one shared identity/org-chart file the whole acos family (cos, acos-email-sort, and future acos skills) reads from — keep it here, not duplicated per skill.

protected_senders.name: Example Contact
protected_senders.reason: ongoing personal/business relationship — never auto-decline or auto-file without a human look

jira_workspaces._comment: Workspace groups for acos-jira-analysis (and future acos skills). Each group is a list of one or more Jira project keys — don't assume one project per group. upcoming_window_days is the shared 'next N days' window every consuming skill should read from here rather than hardcoding.
